air-elemental.actions.2.summary: One Medium or smaller creature in its space: DC 13 Strength save or 4d10 + 2 Thunder, pushed 20 feet and Prone; half on a success.
bronze-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.summary: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a DC 12 Strength save or is pushed 30 feet and has the Prone condition.
darkmantle.actions.1.summary: Creates magical darkness in a 15-foot Emanation; lasts up to 10 minutes with Concentration; darkvision and light are blocked.
fire-elemental.actions.0.summary: Melee +6, reach 5 ft.: 2d6 + 3 Fire damage; the target (creature or flammable object) starts burning.
giant-scorpion.actions.0.summary: Melee +5, reach 5 ft.: 1d6 + 3 Bludgeoning; a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13) by a claw.
green-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.summary: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save: 6d6 Poison damage, or half on a success.
lion.actions.2.summary: One creature within 15 feet makes a DC 11 Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of the lion's next turn.
phase-spider.actions.0.summary: Melee +5, reach 5 ft.: 1d10 + 3 Piercing, 2d8 Poison; reduced to 0 HP makes the target Stable, Poisoned, and Paralyzed for 1 hour.
shambling-mound.actions.0.summary: Melee +7, reach 10 ft.: 1d6 + 4 Bludgeoning and 2d4 Lightning; Medium or smaller targets are pulled 5 feet toward it.
vampire-familiar.actions.1.summary: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.: 1d4 + 3 Piercing and 3d4 Necrotic; at 0 HP, Stable but Poisoned and Paralyzed for 1 hour.
bandit-captain.reactions.0.summary: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack, seeing the attacker and wielding a melee weapon.
dryad.bonus_actions.0.summary: Within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, it teleports to within 5 feet of another such tree up to 60 feet away.
gorgon.bonus_actions.0.summary: A prone creature within 5 feet makes a DC 16 Dexterity save; failure takes 2d10 + 5 Bludgeoning damage, success halves it.
octopus.reactions.0.summary: Underwater, when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet: ink fills a 5-foot Cube (Heavily Obscured, 1 minute) and it swims away.
werebear.bonus_actions.0.summary: Shape-shifts into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid or a Large bear, or back to humanoid form; same statistics except size.
